notes: S3.2 incorrectly treats an accepted input at occ<2 as always incrementing occupancy and, for occ==1, storing the new word into slot1. Under the trusted partial-occupancy semantics, input and output transfers are independent. At occ==1 with in_valid=1 and out_ready=1, both transfers occur on the same edge: the old head is consumed, the new input becomes slot0, and occupancy remains 1. The final RTL handles this case correctly and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
